candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: Using the four input quantities (u_tau, h, y, nu) the only fundamental dimensions present are length (L) and time (T). Dimensionless groups formed are the friction Reynolds number Re_tau = u_tau * h / nu and the wall unit y+ = u_tau * y / nu (equivalently y/h). Therefore the normalized eddy viscosity must be expressible as a function of these two independent dimensionless groups: nu_t/nu = F(Re_tau, y+) (equivalently F(u_tau*h/nu, y/h)).

final_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: Using the four input quantities (u_tau, h, y, nu) the only fundamental dimensions present are length (L) and time (T). Dimensionless groups formed are the friction Reynolds number Re_tau = u_tau * h / nu and the wall unit y+ = u_tau * y / nu (equivalently y/h). Therefore the normalized eddy viscosity must be expressible as a function of these two independent dimensionless groups: nu_t/nu = F(Re_tau, y+) (equivalently F(u_tau*h/nu, y/h)).
